purpose: replace the narrow 118-person Inter-X donor pool with diverse HumanML3D-train AMASS body shapes

source.current_local_state: processed HumanML3D joints/vectors are present; original AMASS archives are absent

selection.split_policy: HumanML3D train only; strip M prefix and deduplicate mirrored clips
selection.identity_policy: deduplicate exact gender plus subject-level AMASS betas before sampling
selection.sampling: two different converted donor identities per Inter-X interaction, fixed seed; source Inter-X identities are not part of this external pool

conversion.reason: SMPL+H and SMPL-X shape spaces are not compatible
conversion.method: official vchoutas/smplx transfer_model smplh2smplx on neutral-pose donor meshes, preserving source gender
conversion.forbidden_shortcut: never copy AMASS SMPL+H beta coefficients directly into SMPL-X
conversion.output: frozen deduplicated SMPL-X beta-plus-gender donor manifest with source hashes and transfer residuals

inventory.deduplication: exact gender plus canonical float64 first-16 beta bytes
inventory.fail_closed: missing, malformed, non-finite, neutral, or unknown-gender AMASS train sources abort the build

transfer_preparation.source_mesh: neutral-pose SMPL+H G with all 16 AMASS betas
transfer_preparation.configs: separate official transfer_model runs for female and male donors
transfer_preparation.batch_size: forced to 1 because the released transfer_model writes an unsliced batch var_dict into every per-path pkl; larger batches can silently mismatch identity and fitted beta
transfer_preparation.provenance: content hashes for inventory, licensed models, correspondence, every generated mesh, frozen configs, official repository revision, trust-region optimizer revision, and compatibility patch
transfer_preparation.runtime: official smplx revision 1265df7ba545e8b00f72e7c557c766e15c71632f plus patches/smplx_transfer_python312_io_compat.patch; official torch-trust-ncg revision 7510ae709bc0722955343e3bd06144406c72c7f0
transfer_preparation.compatibility_patch_scope: Python 3.12 dataclass default_factory and mesh output I/O only; deformation correspondence, losses, trust-region optimizer and fitting logic unchanged

transfer_collection.gate: reapply the official deformation matrix to each frozen SMPL+H source mesh and require fitted SMPL-X vertex RMSE <= 0.01 m
transfer_collection.output: native 10D SMPL-X beta, source gender, identity hash, residual and full artifact provenance
transfer_collection.coverage_report: donor count, gender counts, covariance spectrum/effective rank, and gender-matched bidirectional nearest-neighbour beta distance against the Inter-X train-only 118-shape pool

quality_gate.reject_outlier_policy: reject non-finite, implausible, or above-threshold transferred shapes
quality_gate.comparison: report donor count, beta covariance/effective rank, sex counts, and same-gender nearest-neighbour distance against the 118-shape Inter-X pool

execution.pipeline_order: asset audit -> HumanML3D-train inventory -> neutral SMPL+H render -> official gender-specific transfer -> <=1cm RMSE collection -> seeded Inter-X assignment -> plan audit
execution.asset_failure_policy: fail before rendering or GPU optimization; processed 263D HumanML3D motion is never accepted as an AMASS shape source
execution.old_interx_118_shape_optimizer_shard: paused_and_retained_only_as_recoverable_fallback; not eligible for the final augmentation experiment
execution.contact_and_optimizer_contract: unchanged; only the donor shape pool changes
execution.pilot_before_full_run: rerun the same frozen 25-sample physical and speed gate with converted AMASS donors
